correctness.rationale: An independent C implementation exhaustively enumerated all 2^21 labeled seven-vertex tournaments using the standard Banks maximal-transitive-subtournament definition and uncovered-set covering relation. It reproduced the full joint size histogram, exactly 13,440 strict BA subset UC cases, and fraction 105/16384. Canonicalizing every strict case under all 7! relabelings produced exactly four canonical representatives, with orbit sizes 5040,5040,1680,1680 and one class in each size cell (4,5),(5,6),(3,4),(6,7), agreeing with the frozen claim.
risks: The claim is finite at order seven only; no frequency formula for larger orders follows.
sources: Independent exhaustive C census over all 2,097,152 labeled tournaments and S7 canonicalization
